profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Patch My PC | Ex-Microsoft, Intel, Synapse Health | AI Engineer and Trainer
profile.summary:
With more than 12 years of experience in software engineering, I contribute to Microsoft Azure Edge & Platform Engineering, focusing on distributed systems, REST APIs, and container orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker. By leveraging expertise in Java, programming, and Linux, I help create scalable and impactful software solutions for cloud platforms.  

I collaborate on initiatives that explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and cloud technologies. I enjoy developing innovative and reliable solutions that empower businesses and users worldwide. Passionate about continuous learning and teamwork, I aim to drive meaningful advancements in cloud engineering.
